forecasts.question: Will an Iranian official (Pezeshkian, Araghchi, or named Foreign Ministry spokesperson) make a public statement explicitly addressing the 14-point MOU on the record before EOD 2026-05-13?
forecasts.delta_reason: Resolution criteria met on 2026-05-10/11. Pezeshkian stated on Press TV (May 10): 'We will never bow our heads before the enemy, and if talk of dialogue or negotiation arises, it does not mean surrender or retreat' — directly addressing the negotiation framework. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Baghaei said on May 11 (Press TV, cited by CNBC/NPR): 'Everything we proposed in the plan was reasonable and generous' and 'The plan we have presented is centered on ending the war' — explicitly referencing Iran's counter-proposal to the 14-point framework. Two named officials (Pezeshkian, Baghaei), confirmed by at least three independent outlets (Press TV, CNBC, NPR). Resolution criteria met. Marking at 0.95 pre-formal-resolve to note imminent YES resolution.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a named Iranian official (Pezeshkian, Araghchi, Baghaei, Larijani, or Mojtaba Khamenei) is quoted directly by name in Reuters/AP/AFP/IRNA/Press TV/Tasnim addressing the specific 14-point framework or its terms (not generic 'reviewing US proposals'). NO if only Pakistani-channel intermediaries comment publicly.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Direct quote in at least two of: Reuters, AP, AFP, IRNA, Press TV, Tasnim, or named-Iranian-official Telegram/X account. Anonymous 'sources' do not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If Iran issues a statement on US-Iran negotiations broadly but does not reference the 14-point framework specifically: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. If Mojtaba addresses the question via written statement (no live address): counts as YES (named official, named question).

indicators.name: Tasnim publishes named Foreign Ministry comment on MOU
indicators.expected_effect: +25pp toward YES if observed; Tasnim is the IRGC-aligned outlet that broke the 14-point response May 2.

indicators.name: Mojtaba Khamenei live televised address
indicators.expected_effect: +30pp toward YES if observed in window; would also materially shift downstream forecasts toward de-escalation.

forecasts.question: Will a written US-Iran framework memorandum (the 14-point document or named successor) be confirmed signed by both parties before EOD 2026-05-18?
forecasts.delta_reason: Trump called Iran's May 10 counter-proposal 'garbage' and the ceasefire 'on massive life support' (CNN, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, NPR, Axios — May 11). Pezeshkian responded with 'we will never bow' language (CNBC, Press TV). The public postures of both principals are maximally incompatible heading into the May 14-15 Trump-Xi Beijing summit, which Axios reported is the next plausible diplomatic window — implying no movement before then. A signed memo by May 18 would require both a Xi-brokered off-ramp and a full reversal of public positions within 72 hours of the Trump-Xi summit, which has no precedent in this conflict. Probability reduced from 0.35 to 0.15. Devil's Advocate note partially accepted: Trump-Xi summit creates a non-zero path, preventing a floor below 0.12.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a named US administration official AND a named Iranian official publicly confirm signing of a written memorandum; OR if the document text is published by Axios/Reuters/State Dept with both parties acknowledging authenticity. Verbal/'agreement in principle' does not count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: At least two named official sources from each side, OR official document release by State Dept / Iranian Foreign Ministry / Pakistani Foreign Office acting as confirmed mediator. Reuters/AP/AFP/Axios reporting acceptable when both sides quoted.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If a memo is signed but Iran publicly disputes key terms within 72 hours: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO (per JCPOA-2022 failure pattern). If signed by envoys but not publicly confirmed by principals (Trump/Pezeshkian) by horizon: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Witkoff/Kushner return to Islamabad with Iranian counterpart confirmed in attendance
indicators.expected_effect: +10pp if observed; both delegations physically present is a necessary condition.

indicators.name: IRGC Quds Force statement endorsing diplomatic track
indicators.expected_effect: +15pp if observed; addresses the central JCPOA-2022 failure mode of envoys without IRGC sign-off.

forecasts.question: Will Iran formally and publicly reject the current MOU framework before EOD 2026-05-18?
forecasts.delta_reason: Iran's public posture hardened on May 10-11: Pezeshkian's 'never bow' statement and Baghaei's 'unreasonable demands' framing (Press TV, CNBC, NPR) adopt a defensive-defiant register. However, neither official used formal rejection language (rad, mardud, rejected, refused) about the 14-point framework specifically — both were defending Iran's counter-proposal, not pronouncing the US framework dead. Per ambiguity_rule, counter-proposal posture = NOT rejection. The small probability increase (0.20 to 0.28) reflects the elevated likelihood of hardliner-coordinated escalation if the Trump-Xi summit produces no breakthrough; Kayhan has not yet published explicit rejection-grade language, and Mojtaba Khamenei has issued no written rejection statement.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Iran's Foreign Ministry, Pezeshkian, or Khamenei's office issues a public statement using rejection language (rad, mardud, rejected, refused) about the 14-point framework specifically. NO if Iran continues 'reviewing' or issues a counter-proposal.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Direct attributed quote in IRNA, Press TV, Tasnim, or Reuters/AP/AFP. Statement must name the framework, not generic 'US proposals'.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Counter-proposal with modifications = NOT rejection (resolve NO). Walk-away from talks without explicit rejection statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Kayhan editorial uses rejection-grade language about framework
indicators.expected_effect: +15pp toward YES; Kayhan editorials are coordinated weather-vanes for hardliner positioning.

indicators.name: Mojtaba written statement against framework
indicators.expected_effect: +30pp toward YES; supreme leader rejection is the canonical signal.

forecasts.question: Will IDF conduct a second airstrike on Beirut (within the Greater Beirut municipal area) before EOD 2026-05-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: IDF conducted a week-long ground raid beyond the Litani River with 100+ airstrikes in south Lebanon through May 12 (Times of Israel), establishing a pattern of sustained escalation beyond ceasefire lines. Al Jazeera (May 11) reported 'Israeli killings in Lebanon rise — is even the pretence of a ceasefire over?' — the most intense attacks since the truce began per UNIFIL. However, Smotrich resumed coalition voting after a compromise on reservist compensation (Times of Israel), partially CONTRADICTING the indicator for Beirut strike pressure from coalition dynamics. US-Israel-Lebanon talks scheduled May 14-15 in Washington (State Dept) create a short diplomatic inhibition window. No second Beirut governorate strike confirmed between May 7-12.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if any Israeli airstrike or named operation hits a location within Beirut governorate borders. Southern Lebanon strikes outside Beirut governorate do NOT count. Reported by Lebanese Health Ministry OR Reuters/AP/AFP OR IDF spokesperson.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Lebanese government sources or major wire confirming impact location within Beirut governorate; OR IDF spokesperson statement naming Beirut as target.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Drone strike on Beirut outskirts (Mount Lebanon governorate) = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless explicitly described as 'Beirut strike' by IDF or Lebanese government. Intercepted strike that did not impact = NO.

indicators.name: Smotrich public threat to bolt over Iran-deal terms
indicators.expected_effect: +15pp toward YES if observed; coalition-stabilization Lebanon strikes correlate with explicit Smotrich pressure.

indicators.name: Hezbollah rocket fire from south of Litani at >20/day rate
indicators.expected_effect: +10pp toward YES; would provide Israel justification for Beirut retaliation.

forecasts.question: Will Saudi Arabia publicly restore US access to Prince Sultan Air Base airspace for CENTCOM operations before EOD 2026-05-25?
forecasts.delta_reason: Resolution criteria met on 2026-05-07/08. Wall Street Journal (May 7), Iran International (May 7), and Times of Israel confirmed Saudi Arabia and Kuwait lifted all restrictions on US military access to bases and airspace following a second MBS-Trump phone call. WSJ reporting described the restoration as clearing the path for Project Freedom restart 'as early as this week.' Both Saudi MOFA-equivalent (public lift of restrictions confirmed by WSJ as official KSA government decision) and indirect Pentagon acknowledgment via resumed planning for Project Freedom are confirmed. Marking at 0.95 pre-formal-resolve to note imminent YES resolution; human reviewer should validate ADS-B KC-46 track resumption if accessible.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if KC-46 tanker tracks resume over Saudi Arabia airspace AND Saudi MOFA or Pentagon issues public statement confirming restored access. ADS-B tracking alone = AMBIGUOUS (could be exception). NO if airspace remains closed past 2026-05-25 OR if access is partial/conditional with public Saudi reservation.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Pentagon spokesperson + Saudi MOFA statement; OR Reuters/Bloomberg/Times of Israel confirming sustained access with named DoD source. ADS-B alone is supportive but not resolving.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Partial access (e.g. tankers but not strike aircraft) = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Trump claims access restored without Saudi confirmation = NO.

indicators.name: MBS-Trump phone call or in-person summit
indicators.expected_effect: +15pp toward YES; bilateral reset is the typical precondition.

indicators.name: ADS-B tanker tracks return to Saudi airspace
indicators.expected_effect: +20pp toward YES; operational return precedes public announcement.

forecasts.question: Will at least 50 commercial vessels per day transit the Strait of Hormuz (50%+ of pre-war ~120/day baseline) during any consecutive 7-day window before EOD 2026-06-10?
forecasts.delta_reason: Hormuz transit traffic remained at approximately 5-6 vessels/day as of May 3-5 (Hormuz Strait Monitor, JMIC Update 041 dated 5 May), against a pre-war baseline of 138/day — roughly 4% of baseline, far below the 50-vessel threshold. Lloyd's Market Association confirmed war-risk premiums at 1.5-3% of hull value as of May 6 (Albany Antree War-Risk Insurance Update), with US/UK/Israeli-flagged vessels paying three times more than others — the indicator threshold of 'below 1.5%' remains unmet. Trump's May 11 'garbage' rejection and 'massive life support' framing (Bloomberg, CNN, Al Jazeera) pushed Brent crude to $104.97-107.67 on May 11-12 (Fortune, Hart Energy), implying markets re-priced toward a longer closure window. The single Maersk Alliance Fairfax escort on May 5 has not been followed by resumed commercial convoy operations.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Hormuz Strait Monitor (or UNCTAD, or Lloyd's List) reports ≥50 daily transits averaged over 7 consecutive days within the horizon window. NO if average stays below 50/day for the full horizon window.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Hormuz Strait Monitor (primary), Lloyd's List Intelligence (secondary), UNCTAD Maritime Trade quarterly report (lagging confirmation).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If only Iranian-flagged or sanctions-evading dark-fleet vessels make up the count, but Western insurers still refuse: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO (the operationally meaningful question is whether Western shipping has returned).

indicators.name: Lloyd's war-risk premium reduced below 1.5% of hull
indicators.expected_effect: +20pp toward YES; insurance is the binding constraint on commercial transit.

indicators.name: Maersk/MSC/Frontline announce return to scheduled Hormuz transit
indicators.expected_effect: +25pp toward YES; major shipping lines lead the resumption.

forecasts.question: Will Iran issue a revised formal diplomatic proposal (distinct from the May 2 counter-proposal) addressing the US negotiating position within 5 days of the Trump-Xi Beijing summit (i.e., by EOD 2026-05-20)?
forecasts.delta_reason: Initial seed. Trump-Xi summit scheduled May 14-15 in Beijing (CNBC, Al Jazeera); Axios reported May 11 that talks are unlikely to progress until Trump meets Xi. Araghchi visited Beijing May 6 and secured Chinese pressure on Iran to pursue diplomatic resolution (CNBC). A revised Iranian proposal within 5 days of the summit is plausible if Xi delivers a firm message, but Iran's 'never bow' posture and the nuclear-vs-Hormuz sequencing dispute make rapid concession unlikely. Base rate: Iran issued its first counter-proposal ~8 days after receiving the US framework.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if IRNA, Press TV, or Tasnim reports a new written Iranian proposal or revised counter-proposal submitted to US via Pakistani, Omani, or Chinese channel after the Trump-Xi summit concludes (after EOD 2026-05-15). Must be described as 'new' or 'revised' — restatement of the May 2 counter-proposal does not count. NO if Iran makes no new submission by 2026-05-20.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IRNA, Press TV, or Tasnim direct reporting; OR Reuters/AP/AFP citing named Iranian or Pakistani/Omani/Chinese officials confirming submission of new proposal.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If Iran issues a statement offering to resume talks without submitting a written document: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. If the Pakistani FM announces receipt of a new Iranian message without Iranian confirmation: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Chinese FM Wang Yi issues post-summit joint communique citing Iran talks
indicators.expected_effect: +15pp toward YES if observed; Chinese post-summit communique is the diplomatic vehicle for transmitting Xi's message to Tehran.

indicators.name: Araghchi travels to Muscat or Islamabad post-May 15
indicators.expected_effect: +20pp toward YES; Oman and Pakistan are the active intermediary channels.

forecasts.question: Will CENTCOM resume Project Freedom Hormuz escort operations (at least 3 commercial vessel convoys through the strait under US naval escort) before EOD 2026-05-25?
forecasts.delta_reason: Initial seed. Saudi Arabia and Kuwait restored US basing and airspace access May 7-8, removing the key logistical obstacle (WSJ, Iran International). The Maersk Alliance Fairfax completed a single escorted transit May 5 under Project Freedom v1 before the pause. Resumption is now operationally feasible but tactically constrained: Iran-US negotiations are in public deadlock (Trump 'garbage' rejection, May 11), which elevates IRGC interdiction risk for convoys. Three commercial convoys in 13 days requires either de-escalation or sufficient US naval suppression capacity, both uncertain.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Pentagon spokesperson or CENTCOM confirms at least 3 separate commercial vessel convoys have transited the full length of the Strait of Hormuz under US Navy escort before EOD 2026-05-25. Single-vessel transits count individually if confirmed by Pentagon/CENTCOM. NO if no convoy operations confirmed by that date.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Pentagon spokesperson statement, CENTCOM press release, or Reuters/AP/AFP citing named US military official. Shipping company confirmation (e.g. Maersk press release) is supportive but requires US military co-confirmation.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If escort operation is announced but convoy turns back before completing transit: NO for that convoy. If Iran fires on and US military repels an escort convoy: counts as YES for that convoy if it completed transit.

indicators.name: Pentagon announces Project Freedom restart after Saudi access confirmed
indicators.expected_effect: +20pp toward YES; formal Pentagon announcement is the operational start signal.

indicators.name: Maersk or MSC confirms scheduled convoy slot with CENTCOM
indicators.expected_effect: +15pp toward YES; commercial sign-up is the demand-side confirmation.
